content.value_statement: Clinical teams need clear reports that follow medical and regulatory standards. This skill provides templates, checklists, and validation guidance for case reports, diagnostics, trials, and patient notes.
actual_capabilities: Drafts CARE-aligned case report sections with consent and de-identification prompts.
Provides templates for radiology, pathology, laboratory, SOAP, H&P, consult, and discharge reports.
Guides SAE and clinical study report writing against ICH-E3 and CONSORT structures.
Checks documentation completeness with quality, HIPAA, and report-specific checklists.
Includes local scripts for templates, de-identification checks, case validation, adverse event tables, and terminology review.
limitations: Does not replace clinician review, medical judgment, or legal compliance review.
Validation scripts use simple text rules and may miss context-specific issues.
Some workflows reference external visual schematic tooling that is not included in this package.
Users must remove real PHI before sharing content with AI tools.

use_cases.title: Draft a Journal Case Report
use_cases.description: Turn de-identified case notes into a CARE-aligned outline, narrative, timeline, and missing-information list.

use_cases.title: Standardize Patient Documentation
use_cases.description: Create SOAP notes, H&P documents, consult notes, and discharge summaries with consistent medical structure.

use_cases.title: Prepare Trial Safety Reports
use_cases.description: Format SAE narratives, adverse event tables, and clinical study report sections using trial reporting conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Case Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the clinical-reports skill to draft a CARE-aligned case report from these de-identified notes: [paste notes]. Include missing-information questions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Diagnostic Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured radiology report for this de-identified study: [paste findings]. Use clear sections and critical result language when needed.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an SAE Narrative
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this de-identified adverse event timeline into an SAE report. Include seriousness, causality, expectedness, outcome, and follow-up needs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Report Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this de-identified clinical report package for completeness, HIPAA identifiers, terminology issues, and guideline alignment. Return prioritized revision notes.

output_examples.input: A de-identified case timeline for an unusual presentation.
output: CARE-aligned case report outline with title, abstract, patient information, timeline, diagnostic assessment, intervention, outcome, and discussion sections.
A list of missing details, including consent status, follow-up duration, and supporting literature needs.

output_examples.input: A draft SOAP note with scattered symptoms, vitals, and plan details.
output: A cleaned SOAP note with subjective, objective, assessment, and plan sections.
A quality review highlighting unclear abbreviations, missing follow-up, and privacy checks.

output_examples.input: Adverse event data and a trial timeline.
output: A serious adverse event narrative with onset, severity, causality, expectedness, actions taken, and outcome.
A summary table plan for adverse events by treatment arm and seriousness.

best_practices: Use only de-identified clinical content and verify HIPAA identifiers before sharing text.
Confirm every diagnosis, medication, dose, and date against the source record.
Use the included checklist for the specific report type before final review.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the model to invent clinical facts, outcomes, citations, or consent status.
Do not use generated text as final medical advice without clinician review.
Do not paste PHI, images with identifiers, or regulated trial data without approved safeguards.

faq.question: Does this skill replace a clinician or medical writer?
faq.answer: No. It supports drafting and review, but qualified professionals must verify medical accuracy and compliance.

faq.question: Can I use real patient information?
faq.answer: Use de-identified content only unless your organization has approved safeguards for PHI and AI tools.

faq.question: Which standards does it support?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for CARE, ICH-E3, CONSORT, HIPAA, ACR, CAP, and common clinical documentation formats.

faq.question: Are the validation scripts automatic?
faq.answer: No. They are local command-line helpers that users run when they choose.

faq.question: Can it create final regulatory submissions?
faq.answer: It can help draft and organize content, but regulatory submissions require sponsor and compliance review.

faq.question: Does it generate clinical figures?
faq.answer: It recommends figure workflows, but some referenced schematic tooling is separate from this package.
